name: Max Healthcare
title: Presentation of earnings update for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

read.thesis: Network revenue +20% YoY with occupancy flat at 77% and 758 beds added; ARPP +8% and PAT +10% YoY, with net debt down to ₹2,369 Cr from ₹2,384 Cr; capacity growth is outpacing occupancy gains.

utilisation.quote: Bed occupancy for the quarter was at 77%, with Occupied Bed Days (OBDs) up by 13% YoY

capex.quote: The Board has approved capital expenditure of ₹ 415 Cr for addition of 209 brownfield beds across existing hospitals.

triggers.label: Occupancy flat at 77% YoY
triggers.quote: Average occupancy was 77% in both Q2 FY27 and Q2 FY26, compared to 75% in Q1 FY27

triggers.label: Fresh ₹415 Cr brownfield capex for 209 beds
triggers.quote: The Board has approved capital expenditure of ₹ 415 Cr for addition of 209 brownfield beds across existing hospitals.

triggers.label: Ex-oncology revenue +25% YoY
triggers.quote: Excluding Oncology services, the Gross Revenue grew by +25% YoY

triggers.label: Receivable days up to 93
triggers.quote: Represents DSO of 93 days at the end of Sep’26 vs 87 days at the end of Mar’26

guidance.value: Net debt ₹2,369 Cr at Sep-26 vs ₹2,384 Cr at Jun-26
guidance.quote: Net Debt at end of Sep ‘26 stood at ₹ 2,369 Cr compared to ₹ 2,384 Cr at end of Jun ‘26

prior_guidance_check.metric: Nanavati and Max Smart EBITDA ramp

red_flags.label: Institutional bed share down to 29.3% from 34.0%; oncology drug discontinuation
red_flags.quote: Discontinuation of select chemotherapy drugs for institutional patients led to a drop in share of Oncology in IPD revenues to 21% from 26% in Q2 FY26

red_flags.label: Receivable days rising to 93 from 87
red_flags.quote: Represents DSO of 93 days at the end of Sep’26 vs 87 days at the end of Mar’26
